description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableAclEntry' implementing the 'AclEntry' interface, representing an access control list entry with methods for creation, validation, JSON serialization, and equality checks. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.things' package and handles permissions and authorization subjects.

classes.name: ImmutableAclEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the AclEntry interface, representing an access control list entry with methods for creation, validation, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry with specified AuthorizationSubject and permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry from JSON key and value, parsing permissions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclEntry from a JsonObject, extracting the first relevant field.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the AuthorizationSubject associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains a specific permission.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains all permissions in a collection.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL entry to a JsonObject with optional filtering.
